summary: SplitSync Iteration 9 (deploy-prep: pinned httpx==0.28.1 in requirements.txt via pip freeze; removed .env from .gitignore). Backend-only regression as requested. Backend boots cleanly after `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` (probe GET /api/ → 200). Full 119/119 pytest suite passes in serial (`pytest -n 0`, 144.03s) covering: /api/auth/session, /api/auth/me (Bearer required), /api/expenses CRUD + validation (amount>0, currency USD/INR/EUR/GBP/JPY whitelist, receipt size cap 413), /api/friends CRUD, /api/groups CRUD, /api/settlements + balance subtraction, /api/recurring materialization + validation (amount, currency, cadence monthly/weekly), /api/scan (413 size cap + 429 per-user hourly rate limit at the 21st call + generic 502 surface with no stack leak), /api/insights (default + specific month + FX + empty month + auth), /api/trends (2–24 month bounds, FX conversion, per-month distribution), /api/fx (USD/INR/EUR/GBP/JPY), /api/expenses/{id}/receipt round-trip, CORS preflight with allow_credentials=false. httpx import validated at runtime: `python -c 'import httpx; print(httpx.__version__)'` → 0.28.1. Only stderr entries in backend.err.log are the intentional LLM BadRequestError from TestScanLLMFailureSurface exercising the 502 catch path — expected, not a boot regression. No frontend testing was performed per review-request scope (testing_type=backend only).
